**Coaching Note (for the club player):**

Your rook on f8 was pinned to your king by White's bishop on e5—it couldn't leave the back rank. White played Qe8, attacking the pinned rook with an unstoppable threat of Qxf8#. Your rook had no escape: you couldn't defend it or block because the pin was absolute. This is the power of pins—a pinned piece is a liability. Always check whether your defender pieces are pinned before relying on them.
